meta: Looking for the best facial in Bali? Korean facial studios vs resort spas vs clinics, what to check before booking, and our two studios in Uluwatu.
intro: Bali has hundreds of places offering facials, from beach-side salons to five-star resort spas and medical clinics. The best facial in Bali is not the most expensive one: it is the one matched to your skin, your plans and the climate. Here is how to choose, what to check before booking, and where to find us in Uluwatu.
body_html:
The 4 types of facial venues in Bali

Venue What you get Best for
Local beauty salon Short, affordable, manual facials A quick refresh on a budget
Resort or day spa Relaxing facials in a beautiful setting Pampering, holidays, couples
Korean facial studio Technology + active serums + skin analysis Visible results: glow, pores, acne, firmness
Aesthetic clinic Medical treatments (lasers, injectables, peels) Medical concerns, with a doctor

7 things that make a great facial in Bali

  1. A skin analysis before you start, not a one-size-fits-all menu.
  2. Facial specialists, not therapists who switch between nails, hair and massage.
  3. Protocols adapted to the tropics: gentle exfoliation, strong hydration, SPF to finish.
  4. Professional technology: hydrodermabrasion, LED, ultrasonic infusion, radiofrequency.
  5. Authentic products from official distributors.
  6. Transparent pricing, with tax and service included.
  7. Real reviews on Google and Fresha that mention therapists by name.

Why Korean facials are so popular in Bali

Korean skincare focuses on hydration, barrier repair and glow, exactly what skin needs after sun, salt water and air-conditioning. A Korean Hydrafacial combines deep pore cleansing with serum infusion, so you see results right away without downtime. That makes it ideal for travellers on a short stay.

Our most-booked facials

  • Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (80 min, IDR 1,300K) — our signature glass skin facial in Bali, the full reset
  • PDRN Cellular Repair (Salmon DNA) (60 min, IDR 1,300K) — barrier repair after sun
  • K-Balance Acne Clear (70 min, IDR 1,200K) — blackheads and breakouts
  • Vitamin C Sunshine Glow (60 min, IDR 1,150K) — radiance and even tone
  • Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift (70 min, IDR 1,500K, Ungasan only) — firmness and lift

All prices include 15% tax and service charge, and every treatment starts with a complimentary skin analysis.

Where to book a Korean facial in Uluwatu

We have two studios in Uluwatu: Point Face Ungasan, close to Melasti, Pandawa and the Ungasan cliffs, and Point Face Bingin, in Bingin Downtown Avenue near Bingin and Padang Padang beaches. Korean Hydrafacials are available in both; HydroJelly facials are exclusive to Ungasan, and body treatments are exclusive to Bingin.

faq: What is the best facial in Bali?
The one matched to your skin. For visible glow and hydration after sun, a Korean Hydrafacial is a strong choice.
How much is a good facial in Bali?
At Point Face, Korean Hydrafacials range from IDR 1,150K to 1,300K, and HydroJelly facials go up to IDR 1,500K, tax and service included.
Is it safe to get a facial on holiday?
Yes, if the protocol avoids aggressive peels and you protect your skin from the sun afterwards.
Do I need to book in advance?
In high season (July–August and December–January), we recommend booking a few days ahead.
